# Antibiotic Prophylaxis for Placement of Percutaneous Gastrostomy (PEG) Tube

Antibiotics are recommended for all patients prior to placement of PEG tube

to reduce the risk of peristomal wound infection.

# Preferred Prophylaxis:

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# Alternative for patient with severe penicillin allergy:

[Beta-lactam Allergy Assessment](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)

[Clindamycin 600 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes](psjizid-clindamycin-600mg-iv-once-c)

before incision ($$) [H,O]
